# fct_sales_activities

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_sales_activities` · dbt area: `growth`

Hubspot engagement records for the Membership Sales team, including calls, emails, meetings, and tasks. Each row is one activity-contact combination (engagements with multiple contacts are unnested). Tracks activity type, status, direction, duration, outcomes, and assignment/completion timestamps. Sourced from Hubspot.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `sales_activity_id` | Unique key assigned to each activity, equivalent to the engagement_id >> SOURCE - Hubspot data_tests: - not_null - unique |
| `activity_at` | When the sales activity occured >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `activity_status` | The current status of the activity, such as COMPLETED >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `activity_type` | Whether the activity is a CALL, EMAIL, MEETING, TASK, or INCOMING EMAIL. >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `advisor_lead_id` | Foreign key reference to the Advisor Lead table. Equivalent to the Contact ID >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `assigned_at` | When the activity was assigned to an owner >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `body_preview` | A text preview of the body of the activity, such as an email Body  >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `call_connected_count` | The number of times a call was connected >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `call_direction` | Whether it was an inbound or outbound call >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `call_duration_seconds` | Length of the call, in seconds >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `call_voicemail_count` | The number of times a call went to voicemail >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `created_at` | When the activity was first created in Hubspot >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `created_by_user_id` | The Hubspot user ID of who created the activity >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `email_from_addresses` | List of 'from' addresses on an email activity. May be different from 'sender' >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `email_logged_from` | Which system the email was logged from >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `email_sender_addresses` | List of 'sender' addresses on an email activity, May be different from 'from' >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `email_to_addresses` | List of 'to' addresses on an email activity >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `engagement_id` | The unique ID of the hubspot engagement AKA sales activity >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `engagement_source` | Where the sales activity originated from, such as the CRM UI or an API >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `is_call_imported` | Whether a call activity was imported >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `is_inbound_email_activity_type` | Whether the activity is an inbound email from a contact. >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `is_task_overdue` | Whether a task is currently overdue >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `is_task_sequence_completed` | Whether the sequence associated with the task is completed >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `meeting_first_outreach_at` | When the first outreach to a contact was for a meeting activity >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `object_source_detail` | Details about the source object for the sales activity in Hubspot >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `object_source` | The name of the source object for the sales activity in Hubspot >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `owner_email` | The email address of the owner assigned to the activity >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `owner_full_name` | The full name of the owner assigned to the activity >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `owner_id` | The unique ID of the owner (not the same as the user ID) >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `subject_line_title` | The subject line OR the title of the activity >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `task_completed_at` | When a task was marked completed >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `task_completed_count` | The number of completed tasks >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `task_for_object_type` | Which object type the task was created for >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `task_priority` | The level of prioritization of the task, such as High/Medium/Low >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `task_type` | The type of task, such as Email or Call >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `updated_at` | When the sales activity record was last updated >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
| `updated_by_user_id` | The user ID of whomever last updated the sales activity record >> SOURCE - Hubspot |
